title: 第一百五十九章 失败第一百五十八章 是他
content_zh:
;;
“天赋异禀！能和那位小天龙相提并论了。”矮瘦老头道。
“此言尚早，我承认他的灵阵造诣很高，但再高又能高到哪里去？也超不过四品吧，甚至他还没达到四品。”美妇道，“先前和你们对弈，用的兽火，颜色很深，我估摸着是三阶兽火。以三阶兽火的强横，足矣摧毁大部分二品灵纹，乃至三品灵纹。这三场对弈他是取巧了的，真实实力并不比你们三人高。”
“那小鬼哪能与小天龙相提并论？”美妇轻蔑道。
“多说无益，我们进去看看就知道了。”中年炼药师道。
“对。”老翁也道。
“进去？还是别去了吧，我们就是被他赶出来的。”美妇不满道。
“他不知道你们的身份，城主也不知道吗？”中年灵子道。
白袍青年尴尬道：“那少年的师父是叶家嫡系子弟，我即使亮出身份也压不住。”
叶家嫡系！
叶家什么身份？那可是能够与丹塔叫板的存在，整个神州数一数二的大家族。白袍青年不傻，他可不敢得罪叶家，为自己树敌。
“我还就不信了，这六品灵阵即使是四品灵阵师来了也要琢磨个大半天才敢下手，就凭他怎么可能修复……”美妇话到一半。
突然轰的一声！地动天摇，脚下猛烈的晃动了一下，美妇被摇得重心不稳，一个踉跄差点摔倒。
“小心。”白袍青年环住她的腰肢，这才让她稳住。
“怎么回事？”美妇困惑道。
“你们看那边，传送阵开了！”中年灵阵师惊呼道。
还真的修复了！
突如其来的打脸让美妇脸上绷不住：“这……怎么可能？他真的修复了传送阵？”
这才花了多久啊？前前后后不到半炷香时间吧！
她可是足足观察了两天，才勉强弄清楚整个灵阵的大致。她前前后后修改了数十次的修复方案，这才敢动手修复灵阵。没想到楚天舒一下子就修复成功了。

“不是吧？真成功了！”萧正柯又一次被楚天舒刷新了眼界。
叶尘驾驶飞舟缓缓驶来，沐芸带着楚天舒与柳缦上舟。
萧正柯：“慢走。”
楚天舒：“多谢关照。”
柳缦在飞舟上向萧正柯行了个礼：“这些时日，多谢城主关照。”
“别想那么多，跟着楚天舒。”萧正柯道。
“嗯。”柳缦点点头。
传送阵运转，一道光柱自下而上贯穿天际。飞舟驶入光柱，在阵法空间之力的包裹下很快就消失在原地。
就在楚天舒一行人被传送走之时，另一伙人闯入了地坛周边。
“传送阵居然被修复好了！”中年灵阵师道。
“不可能呀……”美妇死死盯着传送阵。
在她眼前传送阵模样大变，几处故障的漏洞仿佛消失不见，灵阵运转畅通无阻，灵纹阵眼排列整齐有序，一些黯淡无光的灵纹更是被重新激活。
“他真的修复成功了，太好了，这样我们也可以使用了。”白袍青年道。

"Extraordinary talent! He can be compared with that little Tianlong." said the short and thin old man.
"It's too early to say this. I admit that his spiritual formation attainments are very high, but no matter how high he is, how high can he be? He can't surpass the fourth rank, and he has not even reached the fourth rank." The beautiful woman said, "I played against you before, using beast fire, Yan The color is very dark, I guess it is a third-level beast fire. The strength of the third-level beast fire is enough to destroy most of the second-level spiritual marks, and even the third-level spiritual marks. He is playing tricks in these three games, and his real strength is not higher than the three of you."
"How can that little devil be compared with Little Tianlong?" the beautiful woman said scornfully.
"It's useless to talk more. We'll find out when we go in and take a look." The middle-aged alchemist said.
"Yes." The old man also said.
"Go in? It's better not to go in. We were kicked out by him." The beautiful woman said dissatisfied.
"He doesn't know your identities, doesn't the city lord know either?" said the middle-aged Lingzi.
The young man in white robe said awkwardly: "That young man's master is a direct descendant of the Ye family. Even if I reveal my identity, I can't suppress him."
A direct descendant of the Ye family!
What is the identity of the Ye family? That is an existence that can challenge Danta, one of the best families in the entire China. The young man in white robe is not stupid, he does not dare to offend the Ye family and make enemies for himself.
"I still don't believe it. Even a fourth-grade spiritual formation master would have to think about it for a long time before he dares to take action on this sixth-grade spiritual formation. How could he possibly repair it..." The beautiful woman was halfway through her words.
Suddenly there was a bang! The earth shook and the sky shook, and the feet shook violently. The beautiful woman was shaken so that her center of gravity was unsteady, and she staggered and almost fell.
"Be careful." The young man in white robe put his arm around her waist to steady her.
"What's going on?" the beautiful woman asked confused.
"Look over there, the teleportation array is open!" the middle-aged spiritual array master exclaimed.
It was really repaired!
The sudden slap in the face made the beautiful woman's face tense: "This...how is it possible? He really repaired the teleportation array?"
How long did this take? It takes less than half the time to burn incense!
It took her two full days of observation before she could barely figure out the general outline of the entire spiritual formation. She revised the repair plan dozens of times before she dared to repair the spiritual array. Unexpectedly, Chu Tianshu successfully repaired it all of a sudden.
"Isn't it? It was really successful!" Xiao Zhengke's horizons were refreshed by Chu Tianshu again.
Ye Chen drove the flying boat slowly, and Mu Yun took Chu Tianshu and Liu Man on the boat.
Xiao Zhengke: "Walk slowly."
Chu Tianshu: "Thank you for taking care of me."
Liu Man saluted Xiao Zhengke on the flying boat: "Thank you City Lord for your care during these days."
"Don't think so much, just follow Chu Tianshu." Xiao Zhengke said.
"Yeah." Liu Man nodded.
The teleportation array was operating, and a beam of light penetrated the sky from bottom to top. The flying boat sailed into the light pillar and quickly disappeared under the power of the formation space.
Just as Chu Tianshu and his party were teleported away, another group of people broke into the area around the Temple of Earth.
"The teleportation array has actually been repaired!" said the middle-aged spiritual array master.
"It's impossible..." The beautiful woman stared at the teleportation array.
In front of her eyes, the appearance of the teleportation array changed drastically. Several faulty loopholes seemed to disappear. The spirit array was operating smoothly, the spirit pattern eyes were arranged neatly and orderly, and some dim spirit patterns were reactivated.
"He really repaired it successfully, which is great, so we can use it too." The young man in white robe said.
